data.name: My Music Label
data.detailed_description:
Build your label. Shape careers. Make music history. 

My Music Label is a music management and simulation game where you take full control of your own record label.
From discovering promising young talents to managing legendary artists, including artists inspired by today’s music scene, every decision matters and shapes the evolution of the music industry you build.

Strategy, intuition, and vision are essential to establish your label, create iconic careers, and leave a lasting mark on music history.

🎤 Create your label, define your vision

Choose your label’s name, identity, and infrastructure.
Expand your offices, improve production capabilities, optimize internal management, and grow your company to compete with the biggest names in the industry.

👤 From manager to artist

In My Music Label, you’re not just an executive.
You can create your manager, but also become an artist within your own label, live your musical career, and balance personal success with management responsibilities.

🌍 A living, event-driven gameplay experience

The game features a dynamic event system that affects both your artists and your label.

  • Buzz moments: a track goes viral, a documentary boosts an artist’s or label’s popularity, media attention skyrockets.

  • Bad buzz: scandals, controversies, communication mistakes, or plagiarism accusations can damage the image of an artist… or your entire label.

Each event impacts reputation, income, charts, and forces you to make strategic decisions to stay in control.

🎶 Tours, sponsors, and revenue

Organize tours for your artists, choose the right destinations, and manage risks.
Negotiate sponsorship deals to increase your income… sometimes at the cost of artistic compromises.

🏆 The Legends system

Complete special quests to unlock and recruit legends from the past.
These iconic artists can transform your label, inspire new generations, and leave a permanent mark on music history.

🔍 Scouting & recruitment

Travel the world in search of new talent:

  • Scout promising young artists

  • Recruit discovered artists before the competition

  • Develop their potential and build their careers

📊 Charts & music industry

Through platforms like MusicFlow, analyze the charts:

  • By artist

  • By genre

  • By theme

Anticipate trends and adapt your strategy to dominate the rankings.

📱 Social networks & news

An integrated social media system allows you to:

  • Follow album and single releases

  • Stay informed about news related to artists and labels

  • Observe the media impact of your decisions

Reputation matters as much as the numbers.

🔑 Key features

  • Deep music management and simulation

  • Text-based, strategic, and immersive gameplay

  • Dynamic event systems

  • Tours, sponsorships, charts, and social networks

  • Legends system and special quests

  • High replayability 🎶

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intelcore i3 ou équivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD équivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD équivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX
  • VR Support: None
